BATTERY - WMP Visualization Asset Manifest
===========================================

Family display name : Battery
Internal reg name   : Battery
Host DLL            : wmp10-x86\wmp.dll  (32-bit, from Windows Media Player 10 for Windows XP)
COM class (CLSID)   : {8D2A317B-D98B-4efa-89D6-E49F0ACF98A1}

Original registration layout (as written by WMP10 installer):
  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\MediaPlayer\Objects\Effects\Battery\Properties
    val classid     = s '{8D2A317B-D98B-4efa-89D6-E49F0ACF98A1}'
    val name        = s 'res://wmploc.dll/RT_STRING/#1563'
    val description = s 'res://wmploc.dll/RT_STRING/#1564'

Display name resource : wmploc.DLL string table id 1563
Description resource  : wmploc.DLL string table id 1564

Battery internals discovered in wmp.dll:
  - COM interfaces: IBattery, IBatteryPreset, IBatteryRandomPreset, IBatterySavedPreset
  - User presets stored under: HKCU\Software\Microsoft\MediaPlayer\Battery\Presets\<name>
      val Title, PreShiftCount/PostShiftCount, PreShift<N>, CurrentShift, PaletteLocked,
      Palette (binary blob)
  - Internal "shift" classes seen: CJiggyScribble, CStretchShift (effect transform units)
  - References to a default presets file name "BatteryPresets.bpx" (not present in the
    installer payload; presets are created in registry at runtime instead)

Source installer:
  MP10Setup.exe
  URL  : http://ftp.twaren.net/Patch/WinMedia/MP10Setup.exe
  SHA1 : 69862273a5d9d97b4a2e5a3bd93898d259e86657

Extracted file hashes (SHA256):
  wmp.dll   7A1A5F412BBA305AB6A618BD8D2059D5942F9BA317E1BDA40A0F51510FB9E5A3
  wmploc.DLL E5BBE57FA7922627EC96A248CA31786FC6DF427AFC932AF78A5CD12069B6CA11

Hosting notes for MidiaPlayer:
  - App is ia32 (32-bit Electron) so this legacy 32-bit in-proc COM server can load.
  - Plan: write HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{8D2A317B-D98B-4efa-89D6-E49F0ACF98A1}\InprocServer32
    pointing at the shipped wmp.dll path, then CoCreateInstance via koffi,
    query IWMPEffects / IWMPEffects2, call Render(TimedLevel*, HDC, RECT) per frame.
  - TimedLevel struct (WMP SDK): DWORD time; WORD state; UCHAR frequency[2][1024];
    UCHAR waveform[2][1024]. Feed from Web Audio AnalyserNode data each frame.
